content: Progress: exact bounded one-field probe completed under 110s/1.5GiB; 2,061 legal perturbations, expected issued/grant and content/resume guard witnesses. Inspection found a concrete harness blocker: each observation mask resolves join(s,s,mask), which equals s, so styles are not actually tested; state enumeration has no incremental progress/deadline inside a full 2^22-word profile; event/cut/mutation/history phases in the docstring are not implemented in this module. Recording bounded evidence and pushing checkpoint before further probes.
